'''''Nicko''''' was a [[Cargo ferry]] used by [[Airam (group)|Airam]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

The '''Nicko''', along with ''[[Lausbee]]'' were part of an Airam pirate [[Skirmish at Klaatu|raid]] to steal [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] munitions and [[Warhead/Legends|Warheads]]. What the they didn't know was that the convoy was "leaked" to the Airam by [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] as bait to lure Airam members into a trap. The Cargo ferries arrived and [[R-41 Starchaser]]s from [[Jerrid Squadron]] helped disabled the [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighters]] [[Convoy/Legends|(Convoy (BFF-1 bulk freighters)]], while [[R60 T-wing interceptor|T-wings]] from [[Claw Squadron]] were to provide [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] support. However Imperial fighters such as [[Avenger Squadron/Legends|Avenger Squadron]] broke through Claw Squadron and attacked both ships warning them to power down or be threatened to be destroyed. With both ferries surrendering [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|Stormtrooper transports]] from [[Sigma]] were dispatched and the '''Nicko''' and ''Lausbee'' were captured, while their remaining fighters were eliminated, compromising the location of their base and leading to its subsequent destruction.
